70template <class T>
71struct NativeProxyReleases {
72 struct Record {
73 std::any reference;
74 std::function<eve::Result<void>()> release;
75 };
76 static inline std::mutex mutex;
77 static inline std::unordered_map<T*, Record> records;
78};
79
80template <class Ref, class T>
81std::optional<Ref> nativeProxyReference(T* native) {
82 if (!native) return std::nullopt;
83 std::lock_guard lock(NativeProxyReleases<T>::mutex);
84 const auto found = NativeProxyReleases<T>::records.find(native);
85 if (found == NativeProxyReleases<T>::records.end()) return std::nullopt;
86 if (const auto* reference = std::any_cast<Ref>(&found->second.reference)) return *reference;
87 return std::nullopt;
88}

90template <class T>
91SQInteger releaseNativeProxy(SQUserPointer pointer, SQInteger) {
92 auto* native = static_cast<T*>(pointer);
93 if (!native) return 0;
94
95 std::function<eve::Result<void>()> release;
96 {
97 std::lock_guard lock(NativeProxyReleases<T>::mutex);
98 const auto found = NativeProxyReleases<T>::records.find(native);
99 if (found == NativeProxyReleases<T>::records.end()) return 0;
100 release = std::move(found->second.release);
101 NativeProxyReleases<T>::records.erase(found);
102 }
103 release().ignore("release Squirrel procgen native proxy");
104 return 0;
105}

107template <class T, class Ref, class Resolve, class Release>
108ssq::Table makeOwnedNativeProxy(HSQUIRRELVM vm, eve::Result<Ref>&& reference, Resolve&& resolve, Release&& release) {
109 if (!reference) return eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, reference.status(), false, false);
110
111 const auto ref = std::move(reference).takeValue();
112 const auto view = std::invoke(std::forward<Resolve>(resolve), ref);
113 if (!view.isBound()) {
114 std::invoke(release, ref).ignore("rollback unbound Squirrel procgen proxy");
115 return eve::script::projectStatusResult(
116 vm,
117 procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
118 "procgen proxy could not resolve its owned object", "procgen")
119 .status(),
120 false, false);
121 }
122
123 const SQInteger top = sq_gettop(vm);
124 const size_t hashCode = eve::script::detail::squirrelTypeHash<T*>();
125 sq_pushobject(vm, ssq::detail::getClassObj(vm, hashCode));
126 if (SQ_FAILED(sq_createinstance(vm, -1))) {
127 sq_settop(vm, top);
128 std::invoke(release, ref).ignore("rollback failed Squirrel procgen instance");
129 return eve::script::projectStatusResult(
130 vm,
131 procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::Failed, "failed to create Squirrel procgen proxy",
132 "procgen")
133 .status(),
134 false, false);
135 }
136 sq_remove(vm, -2);
137 auto* native = view.get();
138 {
139 std::lock_guard lock(NativeProxyReleases<T>::mutex);
140 NativeProxyReleases<T>::records.emplace(
141 native,
142 typename NativeProxyReleases<T>::Record{
143 ref, [ref, release = std::forward<Release>(release)]() mutable { return std::invoke(release, ref); }});
144 }
145 sq_setinstanceup(vm, -1, native);
146 sq_settypetag(vm, -1, reinterpret_cast<SQUserPointer>(hashCode));
147 sq_setreleasehook(vm, -1, &releaseNativeProxy<T>);
148
149 ssq::Instance value(vm);
150 sq_getstackobj(vm, -1, &value.getRaw());
151 sq_addref(vm, &value.getRaw());
152 sq_settop(vm, top);
153
154 auto result = eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, eve::Status::success(eve::StatusCode::Applied), true, false);
155 result.set("value", value);
156 result.set("ownership", std::string("owned"));
157 result.set("ownerEpoch", static_cast<std::int64_t>(ref.ownerEpoch));
158 result.set("handle", static_cast<std::int64_t>(ref.packed()));
159 return result;
160}

177ssq::Table makeOwnedPointSetProxy(HSQUIRRELVM vm, eve::Result<ProcgenPointSetHandleRef>&& reference) {
178 auto* module = Procgen::create();

219eve::Value artifactProjection(GeneratedArtifact&& artifact) {
220 eve::Value::Array dependencies;
221 dependencies.reserve(artifact.dependencies.size());
222 for (const ArtifactId& dependency : artifact.dependencies) dependencies.emplace_back(dependency.format());
223
224 eve::Value::Object result;
225 result.emplace("id", eve::Value(artifact.id.format()));
226 result.emplace("type", eve::Value(std::string(artifactTypeName(artifact.type))));
227 result.emplace("schemaVersion", eve::Value(static_cast<std::int64_t>(artifact.schemaVersion.value())));
228 result.emplace("buildKey", eve::Value(artifact.buildKey.format()));
229 result.emplace("bounds", boundsValue(artifact.bounds));
230 result.emplace("dependencies", eve::Value(std::move(dependencies)));
231 result.emplace("metadata", eve::Value(std::move(artifact.metadata)));
232 if (artifact.type == ArtifactType::Composite) {
233 const auto* composite = std::get_if<CompositeArtifact>(&artifact.payload);
234 result.emplace("partCount", eve::Value(static_cast<std::int64_t>(composite ? composite->children.size() : 0)));
235 } else {
236 result.emplace("partCount", eve::Value(std::int64_t(1)));
237 }
238 return eve::Value(std::move(result));
239}

251template <class Ref, class Proxy, class Release>
252ssq::Table makeOwnedProxy(HSQUIRRELVM vm, eve::Result<Ref>&& reference, Release&& release) {
253 if (!reference) return eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, reference.status(), false, false);
254 const Ref ref = std::move(reference).takeValue();
255 auto object = eve::script::makeOwnedSquirrelInstance<Proxy>(vm, std::make_unique<Proxy>(ref));
256 if (!object) {
257 const eve::Status status = object.status();
258 object.ignore("failed to create owned procgen proxy");
259 std::invoke(std::forward<Release>(release), ref).ignore("rollback failed owned procgen allocation");
260 return eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, status, false, false);
261 }
262 ssq::Object owned = std::move(object).takeValue();
263 auto result = eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, eve::Status::success(eve::StatusCode::Applied), true, false);
264 result.set("value", owned);
265 result.set("ownership", std::string("owned"));
266 result.set("ownerEpoch", static_cast<std::int64_t>(ref.ownerEpoch));
267 result.set("handle", static_cast<std::int64_t>(ref.packed()));
268 return result;
269}

284ssq::Table projectRecipeDescriptorResult(HSQUIRRELVM vm, eve::Result<RecipeDescriptor>&& result) {
285 const bool ok = result.ok();
286 const eve::Status status = result.status();
287 if (!ok) return eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, status, false, false);
288
289 auto descriptor = std::move(result).takeValue();
290 auto object = eve::script::makeOwnedSquirrelInstance<RecipeDescriptor>(
291 vm, std::make_unique<RecipeDescriptor>(std::move(descriptor)));
292 if (!object) {
293 const eve::Status failure = object.status();
294 object.ignore("failed to create owned Procgen recipe schema");
295 return eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, failure, false, false);
296 }
297
298 auto projected = eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, status, true, true);
299 projected.set("value", std::move(object).takeValue());
300 return projected;
301}

725eve::Result<ProcgenPointSetHandleRef> Procgen::projectToWorldHandle(ProcgenPointSetHandleRef input, float maxY,
726 float minY, std::uint64_t maskBits,
727 bool keepUnmatched) {
728 auto points = resolvePointSet(input);
729 if (!points.isBound())
730 return procgenBindingFailure<ProcgenPointSetHandleRef>(eve::DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
731 "projectToWorld point-set handle is stale", "points");
732 if (!std::isfinite(maxY) || !std::isfinite(minY) || maxY < minY)
733 return procgenBindingFailure<ProcgenPointSetHandleRef>(eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
734 "projectToWorld requires finite maxY >= minY", "maxY");
735 auto* query = eve::cap::query<eve::IProcgenWorldQuery>();
736 if (!query)
737 return procgenBindingFailure<ProcgenPointSetHandleRef>(
738 eve::DiagnosticCode::Unsupported, "projectToWorld requires an IProcgenWorldQuery provider", "worldQuery");
739
740 PointSet output;
741 output.reserve(points->points().size());
742 for (size_t sourceIndex = 0; sourceIndex < points->points().size(); ++sourceIndex) {
743 const auto& source = points->points()[sourceIndex];
744 auto queryResult = query->projectDown(source.x, source.z, maxY, minY, maskBits);
745 if (!queryResult.ok())
746 return procgenBindingFailure<ProcgenPointSetHandleRef>(
747 eve::DiagnosticCode::Failed, "world-query provider failed to execute projection", "worldQuery");
748 const auto& hit = queryResult.value();
749 if (!hit.hit) {
750 if (keepUnmatched)
751 std::move(output.appendPointFrom(*points, sourceIndex)).expect("projectToWorld attribute schema");
752 continue;
753 }
754 ProcgenPoint projected = source;
755 projected.x = hit.x;
756 projected.y = hit.y;
757 projected.z = hit.z;
758 projected.normalX = hit.normalX;
759 projected.normalY = hit.normalY;
760 projected.normalZ = hit.normalZ;
761 const int outputIndex =
762 std::move(output.appendPointFrom(*points, sourceIndex)).expect("projectToWorld attribute schema");
763 output.mutablePoint(size_t(outputIndex)) = std::move(projected);
764 output.trySetIntAttribute(outputIndex, "worldObjectId", hit.objectId).expect("projectToWorld metadata schema");
765 }
766 return ownProcgenObject(ownership_->points, std::make_unique<PointSet>(std::move(output)));
767}

778
779static std::string sceneInstanceId(const PointSet& points, size_t pointIndex,
780 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, size_t>& seedOccurrences) {
781 const auto& point = points.points()[pointIndex];
782 const auto explicitId = points.attributes().getString(pointIndex, "instanceId");
783 if (explicitId && !explicitId->empty()) return std::string(*explicitId);
784 if (point.id != 0) return "pcg-id-" + std::to_string(point.id);
785 return "pcg-" + std::to_string(point.seed) + "-" + std::to_string(seedOccurrences[point.seed]++);
786}
787
788static eve::ProcgenInstanceDesc sceneInstanceDesc(const PointSet& points, size_t pointIndex,
789 const std::string& assetAttribute, const std::string& defaultAsset,
790 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, size_t>& seedOccurrences) {
791 const auto& point = points.points()[pointIndex];
792 eve::ProcgenInstanceDesc instance;
793 instance.sourcePointId = point.id;
794 instance.id = sceneInstanceId(points, pointIndex, seedOccurrences);
795 instance.asset = defaultAsset;
796 if (!assetAttribute.empty()) {
797 const auto found = points.attributes().getString(pointIndex, assetAttribute);
798 if (found) instance.asset = std::string(*found);
799 }
800 instance.x = point.x;
801 instance.y = point.y;
802 instance.z = point.z;
803 instance.yaw = point.yaw;
804 instance.scaleX = point.scaleX;
805 instance.scaleY = point.scaleY;
806 instance.scaleZ = point.scaleZ;
807 instance.seed = point.seed;
808 return instance;
809}
810
811static eve::Result<std::vector<eve::ProcgenInstanceDesc>> sceneInstanceDescs(const PointSet& points,
812 const std::string& assetAttribute,
813 const std::string& defaultAsset,
814 bool requireStablePointIds) {
815 std::vector<eve::ProcgenInstanceDesc> instances;
816 instances.reserve(points.points().size());
817 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, size_t> seedOccurrences;
818 std::unordered_set<std::string> instanceIds;
819 std::unordered_set<uint64_t> pointIds;
820 for (size_t pointIndex = 0; pointIndex < points.points().size(); ++pointIndex) {
821 auto instance = sceneInstanceDesc(points, pointIndex, assetAttribute, defaultAsset, seedOccurrences);
822 if (!instanceIds.insert(instance.id).second)
823 return eve::Result<std::vector<eve::ProcgenInstanceDesc>>::failure(
824 eve::Diagnostic::error(eve::DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
825 "procedural Scene snapshot contains a duplicate instance id", "instanceId"));
826 if (requireStablePointIds && (instance.sourcePointId == 0 || !pointIds.insert(instance.sourcePointId).second))
827 return eve::Result<std::vector<eve::ProcgenInstanceDesc>>::failure(eve::Diagnostic::error(
828 eve::DiagnosticCode::Conflict, "procedural Scene snapshot requires unique non-zero source PointIds",
829 "pointId"));
830 instances.push_back(std::move(instance));
831 }
832 return eve::Result<std::vector<eve::ProcgenInstanceDesc>>::success(std::move(instances));
833}
834
835eve::Result<void> Procgen::publishInstances(const std::string& batchId, ProcgenPointSetHandleRef points,
836 const std::string& assetAttribute, const std::string& defaultAsset) {
837 const auto view = resolvePointSet(points);
838 if (batchId.empty() || !view.isBound())
839 return procgenBindingFailure<void>(
840 !view.isBound() ? eve::DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle : eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
841 "publishInstances requires a batch id and a live point-set handle");
842 auto* sink = eve::cap::query<eve::IProcgenSceneSink>();
843 if (!sink)
844 return procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::Failed, "publishInstances scene sink is unavailable");
845
846 auto instances = sceneInstanceDescs(*view, assetAttribute, defaultAsset, false);
847 if (!instances.ok()) return eve::Result<void>::failure(instances.status());
848 if (!sink->applyBatch(batchId, instances.value()))
849 return procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::Failed, "publishInstances scene sink rejected batch");
850 return eve::Result<void>::success();
851}

875eve::Result<uint64_t> Procgen::publishCellSnapshot(const std::string& prefix, const ProcgenCellRequest& request,
876 ProcgenPointSetHandleRef points, uint64_t targetRevision,
877 const std::string& assetAttribute, const std::string& defaultAsset) {
878 const auto view = resolvePointSet(points);
879 if (prefix.empty() || targetRevision == 0 || !view.isBound())
880 return procgenBindingFailure<uint64_t>(
881 !view.isBound() ? eve::DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle : eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
882 "publishCellSnapshot requires a prefix, live point set, and non-zero target revision",
883 "publishCellSnapshot");
884 auto* sink = eve::cap::query<eve::IProcgenSceneSink>();
885 if (!sink)
886 return procgenBindingFailure<uint64_t>(eve::DiagnosticCode::Failed,
887 "publishCellSnapshot scene sink is unavailable");
888 auto instances = sceneInstanceDescs(*view, assetAttribute, defaultAsset, true);
889 if (!instances.ok()) return eve::Result<uint64_t>::failure(instances.status());
890 const std::string batchId = prefix + "/L" + std::to_string(request.getLevel()) + "/" +
891 std::to_string(request.getX()) + "/" + std::to_string(request.getZ());
892 return sink->replaceBatch(batchId, targetRevision, instances.value());
893}
894
895eve::Result<uint64_t> Procgen::publishCellInstanceDelta(const std::string& prefix, const ProcgenCellRequest& request,
896 const PointDelta& delta, uint64_t targetRevision,
897 const std::string& assetAttribute,
898 const std::string& defaultAsset) {
899 if (prefix.empty())
900 return procgenBindingFailure<uint64_t>(eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
901 "publishCellInstanceDelta requires a prefix", "prefix");
902 if (targetRevision < 2)
903 return procgenBindingFailure<uint64_t>(eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
904 "publishCellInstanceDelta requires a target revision greater than one",
905 "targetRevision");
906 auto* sink = eve::cap::query<eve::IProcgenSceneSink>();
907 if (!sink)
908 return procgenBindingFailure<uint64_t>(eve::DiagnosticCode::Failed,
909 "publishCellInstanceDelta scene sink is unavailable");
910
911 eve::ProcgenInstanceDelta sceneDelta;
912 sceneDelta.baseRevision = targetRevision - 1;
913 sceneDelta.targetRevision = targetRevision;
914 sceneDelta.removedPointIds = delta.removed;
915 sceneDelta.targetPointOrder = delta.targetOrder;
916 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, size_t> seedOccurrences;
917 sceneDelta.added.reserve(delta.added.points().size());
918 for (size_t pointIndex = 0; pointIndex < delta.added.points().size(); ++pointIndex)
919 sceneDelta.added.push_back(
920 sceneInstanceDesc(delta.added, pointIndex, assetAttribute, defaultAsset, seedOccurrences));
921 seedOccurrences.clear();
922 sceneDelta.updated.reserve(delta.updated.points().size());
923 for (size_t pointIndex = 0; pointIndex < delta.updated.points().size(); ++pointIndex)
924 sceneDelta.updated.push_back(
925 sceneInstanceDesc(delta.updated, pointIndex, assetAttribute, defaultAsset, seedOccurrences));
926
927 const std::string batchId = prefix + "/L" + std::to_string(request.getLevel()) + "/" +
928 std::to_string(request.getX()) + "/" + std::to_string(request.getZ());
929 return sink->applyDelta(batchId, sceneDelta);
930}
931
932eve::Result<uint64_t> Procgen::synchronizeCellInstances(const std::string& prefix, const RuntimeGeneration& runtime,
933 const ProcgenCellRequest& request,
934 const std::string& assetAttribute,
935 const std::string& defaultAsset) {
936 if (prefix.empty())
937 return procgenBindingFailure<uint64_t>(eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
938 "synchronizeCellInstances requires a prefix", "prefix");
939 const int level = request.getLevel();
940 const int x = request.getX();
941 const int z = request.getZ();
942 const uint64_t targetRevision = runtime.getCellRevision(level, x, z);
943 std::unique_ptr<PointSet> snapshot(runtime.getCellOutput(level, x, z));
944 if (!snapshot || targetRevision == 0)
945 return procgenBindingFailure<uint64_t>(eve::DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
946 "synchronizeCellInstances requires an active runtime cell", "cell");
947
948 auto* sink = eve::cap::query<eve::IProcgenSceneSink>();
949 if (!sink)
950 return procgenBindingFailure<uint64_t>(eve::DiagnosticCode::Failed,
951 "synchronizeCellInstances scene sink is unavailable");
952 const std::string batchId =
953 prefix + "/L" + std::to_string(level) + "/" + std::to_string(x) + "/" + std::to_string(z);
954 const uint64_t sceneRevision = sink->batchRevision(batchId);
955 if (sceneRevision == targetRevision) return eve::Result<uint64_t>::success(targetRevision);
956 if (sceneRevision > targetRevision)
957 return procgenBindingFailure<uint64_t>(eve::DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
958 "Scene cell revision is ahead of RuntimeGeneration", "revision");
959
960 if (sceneRevision + 1 == targetRevision) {
961 std::unique_ptr<PointDelta> delta(runtime.getCellDelta(level, x, z));
962 if (delta)
963 return publishCellInstanceDelta(prefix, request, *delta, targetRevision, assetAttribute, defaultAsset);
964 }
965
966 auto instances = sceneInstanceDescs(*snapshot, assetAttribute, defaultAsset, true);
967 if (!instances.ok()) return eve::Result<uint64_t>::failure(instances.status());
968 return sink->replaceBatch(batchId, targetRevision, instances.value());
969}
970
971eve::Result<uint64_t> Procgen::synchronizeCellInstancesAtomic(const std::string& prefix,
972 const std::vector<const RuntimeGeneration*>& runtimes,
973 const std::vector<const ProcgenCellRequest*>& requests,
974 const std::string& assetAttribute,
975 const std::string& defaultAsset) {
976 if (prefix.empty() || runtimes.empty() || runtimes.size() != requests.size())
977 return procgenBindingFailure<uint64_t>(
978 eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
979 "synchronizeCellInstancesAtomic requires a prefix and equally sized non-empty runtime/request lists",
980 "cells");
981 auto* sink = eve::cap::query<eve::IProcgenSceneSink>();
982 if (!sink)
983 return procgenBindingFailure<uint64_t>(eve::DiagnosticCode::Failed,
984 "synchronizeCellInstancesAtomic scene sink is unavailable");
985
986 std::vector<eve::ProcgenBatchSnapshot> snapshots;
987 snapshots.reserve(requests.size());
988 std::unordered_set<std::string> batchIds;
989 for (size_t index = 0; index < requests.size(); ++index) {
990 const auto* runtime = runtimes[index];
991 const auto* request = requests[index];
992 if (!runtime || !request)
993 return procgenBindingFailure<uint64_t>(eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
994 "synchronizeCellInstancesAtomic contains a null cell", "cells");
995 const int level = request->getLevel();
996 const int x = request->getX();
997 const int z = request->getZ();
998 const uint64_t targetRevision = runtime->getCellRevision(level, x, z);
999 std::unique_ptr<PointSet> output(runtime->getCellOutput(level, x, z));
1000 if (!output || targetRevision == 0)
1001 return procgenBindingFailure<uint64_t>(eve::DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
1002 "synchronizeCellInstancesAtomic contains an inactive cell", "cells");
1003 const std::string batchId =
1004 prefix + "/L" + std::to_string(level) + "/" + std::to_string(x) + "/" + std::to_string(z);
1005 if (!batchIds.insert(batchId).second)
1006 return procgenBindingFailure<uint64_t>(eve::DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
1007 "synchronizeCellInstancesAtomic repeats a cell", "cells");
1008 const uint64_t sceneRevision = sink->batchRevision(batchId);
1009 if (sceneRevision > targetRevision)
1010 return procgenBindingFailure<uint64_t>(eve::DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
1011 "Scene cell revision is ahead of RuntimeGeneration", "revision");
1012 if (sceneRevision == targetRevision) continue;
1013 auto instances = sceneInstanceDescs(*output, assetAttribute, defaultAsset, true);
1014 if (!instances) return eve::Result<uint64_t>::failure(instances.status());
1015 snapshots.push_back({batchId, targetRevision, std::move(instances).takeValue()});
1016 }
1017 if (snapshots.empty()) return eve::Result<uint64_t>::success(0);
1018 return sink->replaceBatches(snapshots);
1019}
1020
1021eve::Result<void> Procgen::removeCellInstances(const std::string& prefix, const ProcgenCellRequest& request) {
1022 if (prefix.empty())
1023 return procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
1024 "removeCellInstances requires a prefix");
1025 const std::string batchId = prefix + "/L" + std::to_string(request.getLevel()) + "/" +
1026 std::to_string(request.getX()) + "/" + std::to_string(request.getZ());
1027 return removeInstances(batchId);
1028}
1029
1030eve::Result<uint64_t> Procgen::removeCellInstancesAtomic(const std::string& prefix,
1031 const std::vector<const ProcgenCellRequest*>& requests) {
1032 if (prefix.empty() || requests.empty())
1033 return procgenBindingFailure<uint64_t>(eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
1034 "removeCellInstancesAtomic requires a prefix and cleanup requests",
1035 "requests");
1036 auto* sink = eve::cap::query<eve::IProcgenSceneSink>();
1037 if (!sink)
1038 return procgenBindingFailure<uint64_t>(eve::DiagnosticCode::Failed,
1039 "removeCellInstancesAtomic scene sink is unavailable");
1040 std::vector<std::string> batchIds;
1041 batchIds.reserve(requests.size());
1042 for (const auto* request : requests) {
1043 if (!request)
1044 return procgenBindingFailure<uint64_t>(eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
1045 "removeCellInstancesAtomic contains a null request", "requests");
1046 batchIds.push_back(prefix + "/L" + std::to_string(request->getLevel()) + "/" + std::to_string(request->getX()) +
1047 "/" + std::to_string(request->getZ()));
1048 }
1049 return sink->removeBatches(batchIds);
1050}
1051
1052eve::Result<uint64_t> Procgen::completeCellCleanupAtomic(const std::string& prefix,
1053 const std::vector<RuntimeGeneration*>& runtimes,
1054 const std::vector<const ProcgenCellRequest*>& requests) {
1055 if (prefix.empty() || requests.empty() || runtimes.size() != requests.size())
1056 return procgenBindingFailure<uint64_t>(
1057 eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
1058 "completeCellCleanupAtomic requires a prefix and equally sized runtime/request arrays", "requests");
1059 auto* sink = eve::cap::query<eve::IProcgenSceneSink>();
1060 if (!sink)
1061 return procgenBindingFailure<uint64_t>(eve::DiagnosticCode::Failed,
1062 "completeCellCleanupAtomic scene sink is unavailable");
1063
1064 struct RuntimeCleanupGroup {
1065 RuntimeGeneration* runtime = nullptr;
1066 std::vector<const ProcgenCellRequest*> requests;
1067 };
1068 std::vector<RuntimeCleanupGroup> groups;
1069 std::vector<std::string> batchIds;
1070 groups.reserve(runtimes.size());
1071 batchIds.reserve(requests.size());
1072 for (size_t index = 0; index < requests.size(); ++index) {
1073 auto* runtime = runtimes[index];
1074 auto* request = requests[index];
1075 if (!runtime || !request)
1076 return procgenBindingFailure<uint64_t>(eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
1077 "completeCellCleanupAtomic contains a null runtime or request",
1078 "requests");
1079 auto group = std::find_if(groups.begin(), groups.end(),
1080 [runtime](const auto& candidate) { return candidate.runtime == runtime; });
1081 if (group == groups.end()) {
1082 groups.push_back({runtime, {}});
1083 group = std::prev(groups.end());
1084 }
1085 group->requests.push_back(request);
1086 batchIds.push_back(prefix + "/L" + std::to_string(request->getLevel()) + "/" + std::to_string(request->getX()) +
1087 "/" + std::to_string(request->getZ()));
1088 }
1089 for (const auto& group : groups) {
1090 auto validated = group.runtime->validateCleanups(group.requests);
1091 if (!validated.ok()) return eve::Result<uint64_t>::failure(validated.status());
1092 }
1093 return sink->removeBatchesCoordinated(batchIds, [&groups] {
1094 for (auto& group : groups) group.runtime->eraseValidatedCleanups(group.requests);
1095 return eve::Result<void>::success();
1096 });
1097}

1312eve::Result<ProcgenContextHandleRef> Procgen::beginSystemHandle(const std::string& name, uint32_t seed) {
1313 Procgen* module = Procgen::create();
1314 module->lastError_.clear();
1315
1316 if (name.empty()) {
1317 module->lastError_ = "beginSystem: name is empty";
1318 return procgenBindingFailure<ProcgenContextHandleRef>(eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, module->lastError_,
1319 "context");
1320 }
1321 auto context = std::make_unique<ProcgenContext>(name, seed);
1322 const auto previous = module->systems_.find(name);
1323 if (previous != module->systems_.end()) context->stageCache_ = previous->second.stageCache;
1324 return module->contexts_.emplace(std::move(context));
1325}
1326
1327eve::Result<ProcgenContextHandleRef> Procgen::beginCachedSystemHandle(const std::string& name, uint32_t seed,
1328 const std::string& buildKey) {
1329 Procgen* module = Procgen::create();
1330 module->lastError_.clear();
1331 if (name.empty()) {
1332 module->lastError_ = "beginCachedSystem: name is empty";
1333 return procgenBindingFailure<ProcgenContextHandleRef>(eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, module->lastError_,
1334 "context");
1335 }
1336 if (buildKey.empty()) {
1337 module->lastError_ = "beginCachedSystem: build key is empty";
1338 return procgenBindingFailure<ProcgenContextHandleRef>(eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, module->lastError_,
1339 "buildKey");
1340 }
1341 const uint32_t normalizedSeed = seed ? seed : 1u;
1342 const auto found = module->systems_.find(name);
1343 const bool cacheHit =
1344 found != module->systems_.end() && found->second.seed == normalizedSeed && found->second.buildKey == buildKey;
1345 auto context = std::make_unique<ProcgenContext>(name, normalizedSeed, buildKey, cacheHit);
1346 if (found != module->systems_.end()) context->stageCache_ = found->second.stageCache;
1347 return module->contexts_.emplace(std::move(context));
1348}

1370eve::Result<void> Procgen::commitSystem(ProcgenContextHandleRef reference) {
1371 auto view = Procgen::resolve(reference);
1372 if (!view.isBound())
1373 return procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle, "commitSystem context handle is stale",
1374 "context");
1375 ProcgenContext* context = view.get();
1376 if (!context->isActive())
1377 return procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::PreconditionViolation,
1378 "commitSystem: transaction is closed", "context");
1379 if (context->hasFailed()) {
1380 const std::string error = context->getError();
1381 context->close();
1382 return procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::Failed, "commitSystem: " + error, "context");
1383 }
1384 if (!context->openTraces_.empty()) {
1385 const std::string trace = context->openTraces_.back().name;
1386 context->close();
1387 return procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::PreconditionViolation,
1388 "commitSystem: unfinished trace '" + trace + "'", "context");
1389 }
1390
1391 const auto current = systems_.find(context->name_);
1392 if (current != systems_.end()) previousSystems_[context->name_] = current->second;
1393 auto& snapshot = systems_[context->name_];
1394 snapshot.seed = context->seed_;
1395 snapshot.revision = snapshot.revision + 1u;
1396 snapshot.buildKey = context->buildKey_;
1397 snapshot.outputs = context->outputs_;
1398 snapshot.outputOrder = context->outputOrder_;
1399 snapshot.debugStages = context->debugStages_;
1400 snapshot.debugStageOrder = context->debugStageOrder_;
1401 snapshot.stageCache = context->stageCache_;
1402 snapshot.stageCacheHits = context->stageCacheHits_;
1403 snapshot.stageCacheMisses = context->stageCacheMisses_;
1404 snapshot.traces = context->traces_;
1405 context->close();
1406 return eve::Result<void>::success(eve::Status::success(eve::StatusCode::Applied));
1407}

1409eve::Result<void> Procgen::abortSystem(ProcgenContextHandleRef reference) {
1410 auto view = Procgen::resolve(reference);
1411 if (!view.isBound())
1412 return procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle, "abortSystem context handle is stale",
1413 "context");
1414 view->abort();
1415 return eve::Result<void>::success(eve::Status::success(eve::StatusCode::Applied));
1416}

1503uint64_t Procgen::getPreviousSystemRevision(const std::string& name) const {
1504 const auto found = previousSystems_.find(name);
1505 return found == previousSystems_.end() ? 0u : found->second.revision;
1506}
1507
1508std::string Procgen::getSystemDebugReport(const std::string& name) const {
1509 const auto found = systems_.find(name);
1510 if (found == systems_.end()) return "system '" + name + "' is not committed";
1511 const auto& snapshot = found->second;
1512 std::ostringstream report;
1513 report << name << " revision=" << snapshot.revision << " seed=" << snapshot.seed;
1514 if (!snapshot.buildKey.empty()) report << " buildKey=" << snapshot.buildKey;
1515 report << " stageCache=" << snapshot.stageCacheHits << " hit/" << snapshot.stageCacheMisses << " miss";
1516 for (const auto& trace : snapshot.traces) {
1517 report << "\n " << trace.name << " input=" << trace.inputCount << " output=" << trace.outputCount
1518 << " ms=" << trace.milliseconds;
1519 }
1520 for (const auto& outputName : snapshot.outputOrder) {
1521 report << "\n output " << outputName << " points=" << snapshot.outputs.at(outputName).getCount();
1522 }
1523 for (const auto& stageName : snapshot.debugStageOrder) {
1524 report << "\n debug " << stageName << " points=" << snapshot.debugStages.at(stageName).getCount();
1525 }
1526 return report.str();
1527}
1528
1529std::string Procgen::getSystemDebugDiffReport(const std::string& name) const {
1530 const auto current = systems_.find(name);
1531 if (current == systems_.end()) return "system '" + name + "' is not committed";
1532 const auto previous = previousSystems_.find(name);
1533 if (previous == previousSystems_.end()) return name + " has no previous revision";
1534
1535 std::ostringstream report;
1536 report << name << " revision=" << previous->second.revision << " -> " << current->second.revision;
1537 for (const auto& stageName : current->second.debugStageOrder) {
1538 const int currentCount = current->second.debugStages.at(stageName).getCount();
1539 const auto oldStage = previous->second.debugStages.find(stageName);
1540 const int oldCount = oldStage == previous->second.debugStages.end() ? 0 : oldStage->second.getCount();
1541 report << "\n debug " << stageName << " points=" << currentCount << " delta=";
1542 if (currentCount >= oldCount) report << "+";
1543 report << currentCount - oldCount;
1544 }
1545 for (const auto& stageName : previous->second.debugStageOrder) {
1546 if (current->second.debugStages.find(stageName) != current->second.debugStages.end()) continue;
1547 report << "\n debug " << stageName << " removed delta=-"
1548 << previous->second.debugStages.at(stageName).getCount();
1549 }
1550 return report.str();
1551}

1563eve::Result<ProcgenGridHandleRef> Procgen::generateHandle(const std::string& algorithmId,
1564 ProcgenParamsHandleRef params) {
1565 auto input = Procgen::resolve(params);
1566 if (!input.isBound())
1567 return procgenBindingFailure<ProcgenGridHandleRef>(eve::DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
1568 "generate parameters handle is stale", "params");
1569 auto grid = std::make_unique<Grid2D>();
1570 if (!runGenerate(algorithmId, *input, *grid))
1571 return procgenBindingFailure<ProcgenGridHandleRef>(
1572 eve::DiagnosticCode::Failed, lastError_.empty() ? "generate failed" : lastError_, "algorithm");
1573 return ownProcgenObject(grids_, std::move(grid));
1574}
1575
1576eve::Result<void> Procgen::generateTo(const std::string& algorithmId, ProcgenParamsHandleRef params,
1577 ProcgenOutputHandleRef output) {
1578 auto paramsView = Procgen::resolve(params);
1579 auto outputView = resolveOutput(output);
1580 if (!paramsView.isBound())
1581 return procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle, "generateTo parameter handle is stale",
1582 "params");
1583 if (!outputView.isBound())
1584 return procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle, "generateTo output handle is stale",
1585 "output");
1586 Grid2D grid;
1587 if (!runGenerate(algorithmId, *paramsView, grid))
1588 return procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::Failed,
1589 lastError_.empty() ? "generateTo failed" : lastError_, "algorithm");
1590
1591 const std::string target = outputView->getTarget();
1592 if (target == "grid") {
1593 return procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
1594 "generateTo: target 'grid' has no sink; use generateHandle()",
1595 "output.target");
1596 }
1597 if (target == "tilelayer") {
1598 auto* layer = outputView->getLayer();
1599 if (!layer)
1600 return procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
1601 "generateTo: tilelayer target has no layer", "output.layer");
1602 if (!palettes_.applyToLayer(grid, outputView->getPalette(), layer, &lastError_))
1603 return procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::Failed, lastError_, "output");
1604 return eve::Result<void>::success(eve::Status::success(eve::StatusCode::Applied));
1605 }
1606 if (target == "json") {
1607 if (!writeGridJson(grid, outputView->getPath(), &lastError_))
1608 return procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::Failed, lastError_, "output.path");
1609 return eve::Result<void>::success(eve::Status::success(eve::StatusCode::Applied));
1610 }
1611 return procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
1612 "generateTo: unknown target '" + target + "' (use grid|tilelayer|json)",
1613 "output.target");
1614}

1616eve::Result<void> Procgen::applyToLayer(ProcgenGridHandleRef grid, const std::string& palette, map::TileLayer& layer) {
1617 auto view = Procgen::resolve(grid);
1618 if (!view.isBound())
1619 return procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle, "applyToLayer grid handle is stale",
1620 "grid");
1621 if (!palettes_.applyToLayer(*view, palette, &layer, &lastError_))
1622 return procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::Failed, lastError_, "palette");
1623 return eve::Result<void>::success(eve::Status::success(eve::StatusCode::Applied));
1624}

1827eve::Result<ProcgenNormalImageHandleRef> Procgen::generateNormalImageHandle(const std::string& recipeId,
1828 ProcgenParamsHandleRef params) {
1829 auto input = Procgen::resolve(params);
1830 if (!input.isBound())
1831 return procgenBindingFailure<ProcgenNormalImageHandleRef>(
1832 eve::DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle, "generateNormalImage parameters handle is stale", "params");
1833 auto image = generateImageHandle(recipeId, params);
1834 if (!image)
1835 return procgenBindingFailure<ProcgenNormalImageHandleRef>(eve::DiagnosticCode::Failed,
1836 image.status().describe(), "recipe");
1837 const auto imageRef = std::move(image).takeValue();
1838 auto albedo = ownership_->images.resolve(imageRef);
1839 if (!albedo.isBound()) {
1840 ownership_->images.erase(imageRef).ignore("release unresolvable temporary albedo image");
1841 return procgenBindingFailure<ProcgenNormalImageHandleRef>(eve::DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
1842 "generated albedo image handle is stale", "image");
1843 }
1844 const int w = albedo->getWidth();
1845 const int h = albedo->getHeight();
1846 auto* px = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(albedo->getData());
1847 std::vector<float> height(size_t(w * h));
1848 for (int i = 0; i < w * h; ++i) {
1849 const size_t o = size_t(i) * 4u;
1850 height[size_t(i)] = (float(px[o]) * 0.299f + float(px[o + 1]) * 0.587f + float(px[o + 2]) * 0.114f) / 255.f;
1851 }
1852 const bool seamless = input->getInt("seamless", 1) != 0;
1853 const float strength = input->getFloat("normalStrength", 4.f);
1854 auto normal = heightToNormalImage(height, w, h, strength, seamless);
1855 ownership_->images.erase(imageRef).ignore("release temporary albedo image");
1856 if (!normal)
1857 return procgenBindingFailure<ProcgenNormalImageHandleRef>(eve::DiagnosticCode::Failed,
1858 "generateNormalImage failed", "recipe");
1859 return ownProcgenObject(ownership_->normalImages, std::move(normal));
1860}

1863 Procgen* module = ModuleManager::getInstance<Procgen>("Procgen");
1864 return module ? module->ownership_->normalImages.resolve(reference) : eve::script::Borrowed<image::ImageData>();
1865}

1869 if (!module)

1871 "normalImage");

1881eve::script::Borrowed<graphics::Texture> Procgen::generateTextureBorrowed(const std::string& recipeId,
1882 ProcgenParamsHandleRef params,
1883 graphics::Graphics* gfx) {
1884 auto input = Procgen::resolve(params);
1885 if (!input.isBound() || !gfx) return {};
1886 auto generated = generateImageHandle(recipeId, params);
1887 if (!generated) return {};
1888 const auto imageRef = std::move(generated).takeValue();
1889 auto image = ownership_->images.resolve(imageRef);
1890 if (!image.isBound()) {
1891 ownership_->images.erase(imageRef).ignore("release unresolvable temporary image");
1892 return {};
1893 }
1894 const bool seamless = input->getInt("seamless", 1) != 0;
1895 graphics::Texture* texture = gfx->newTexture(image->getWidth(), image->getHeight(),
1896 static_cast<const uint8_t*>(image->getData()), seamless, seamless);
1897 ownership_->images.erase(imageRef).ignore("release temporary generated image");
1898 return eve::script::Borrowed<graphics::Texture>(texture,
1899 static_cast<std::uint64_t>(reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(gfx)));
1900}

1990eve::Result<void> Procgen::sampleCloud(ProcgenCloudFieldHandleRef field, std::span<float> out, int w, int h, float time,
1991 float x0, float z0, float extent) {
1992 auto view = resolveCloudField(field);
1993 if (!view.isBound())
1994 return procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle, "cloud field handle is stale", "field");
1995 if (w <= 0 || h <= 0 || out.size() < static_cast<std::size_t>(w) * static_cast<std::size_t>(h))
1996 return procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
1997 "cloud output buffer is smaller than width*height", "out");
1998 view->sample(out.data(), w, h, time, x0, z0, extent);
1999 return eve::Result<void>::success(eve::Status::success(eve::StatusCode::Applied));
2000}

2003 float time, float x0, float z0, float extent) {

2005 if (!view.isBound())
2006 return procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle, "cloud shadow handle is stale", "shadow");
2007 if (w <= 0 || h <= 0 || out.size() < static_cast<std::size_t>(w) * static_cast<std::size_t>(h))
2008 return procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2009 "cloud output buffer is smaller than width*height", "out");
2010 view->sampleCoverage(out.data(), w, h, time, x0, z0, extent);
2011 return eve::Result<void>::success(eve::Status::success(eve::StatusCode::Applied));
2012}

2014eve::Result<ProcgenPbrMaterialHandleRef> Procgen::generatePbrMaterialHandle(const std::string& recipeId,
2015 ProcgenParamsHandleRef params) {
2016 auto input = Procgen::resolve(params);
2017 if (!input.isBound())
2018 return procgenBindingFailure<ProcgenPbrMaterialHandleRef>(
2019 eve::DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle, "generatePbrMaterial parameters handle is stale", "params");

2081eve::Result<ProcgenMeshBuildHandleRef> Procgen::buildMeshHandle(const std::string& recipeId,
2082 ProcgenParamsHandleRef params) {
2083 auto built = buildArtifact(recipeId, params, nextCompatibilityArtifactId());
2084 if (!built)
2085 return procgenBindingFailure<ProcgenMeshBuildHandleRef>(eve::DiagnosticCode::Failed, built.status().describe(),
2086 "recipe");
2087 GeneratedArtifact artifact = std::move(built).takeValue();
2088 const MeshBuild* source = nullptr;
2089 if (artifact.type == ArtifactType::MeshData) {
2090 source = &std::get<MeshData>(artifact.payload);
2091 } else if (artifact.type == ArtifactType::Composite) {
2092 const ArtifactPart* part = std::get<CompositeArtifact>(artifact.payload).find("mesh");
2093 if (part && part->type == ArtifactType::MeshData) source = &std::get<MeshData>(part->payload);
2094 }
2095 if (!source)
2096 return procgenBindingFailure<ProcgenMeshBuildHandleRef>(eve::DiagnosticCode::Failed,
2097 "generated artifact has no mesh payload", "recipe");
2098 auto mesh = std::make_unique<MeshBuild>(*source);
2099 ArtifactPublisher publisher(artifactStore_);
2100 auto published = publisher.publish(std::move(artifact), {});
2101 if (!published)
2102 return procgenBindingFailure<ProcgenMeshBuildHandleRef>(eve::DiagnosticCode::Failed,
2103 published.status().describe(), "artifact");
2104 std::move(published).takeValue();
2105 return ownProcgenObject(ownership_->meshes, std::move(mesh));
2106}

2137ArtifactId Procgen::nextCompatibilityArtifactId() noexcept {
2138 static const ArtifactId root = [] {

2483image::ImageData *Procgen::generateTerrainSplatMap(TerrainMeshChunk *chunk) {
2484 lastError_.clear();
2485 if (!chunk || chunk->getSplatWidth() <= 0 || chunk->getSplatHeight() <= 0) {
2486 lastError_ = "generateTerrainSplatMap: a built terrain chunk is required";
2487 return nullptr;
2488 }
2489 auto *image = new image::ImageData(chunk->getSplatWidth(), chunk->getSplatHeight(), "RGBA8");
2490 auto *pixels = static_cast<uint8_t *>(image->getData());
2491 for (int vertex = 0; vertex < chunk->getBaseVertexCount(); ++vertex) {
2492 std::array<int, 4> quantized{};
2493 std::array<float, 4> remainder{};
2494 int total = 0;
2495 for (int channel = 0; channel < 4; ++channel) {
2496 const float scaled = std::clamp(chunk->getMaterialWeight(vertex, channel), 0.f, 1.f) * 255.f;
2497 quantized[channel] = int(std::floor(scaled));
2498 remainder[channel] = scaled - float(quantized[channel]);
2499 total += quantized[channel];
2500 }
2501 while (total < 255) {
2502 const int channel = int(std::max_element(remainder.begin(), remainder.end()) - remainder.begin());
2503 ++quantized[channel];
2504 remainder[channel] = -1.f;
2505 ++total;
2506 }
2507 for (int channel = 0; channel < 4; ++channel)
2508 pixels[size_t(vertex) * 4u + size_t(channel)] = uint8_t(quantized[channel]);
2509 }
2510 return image;
2511}
2512
2513image::ImageData *Procgen::generateTerrainAlbedoMap(TerrainMeshChunk *chunk) {
2514 lastError_.clear();
2515 if (!chunk || chunk->getSplatWidth() <= 0 || chunk->getSplatHeight() <= 0) {
2516 lastError_ = "generateTerrainAlbedoMap: a built terrain chunk is required";
2517 return nullptr;
2518 }
2519 static constexpr std::array<std::array<float, 3>, 4> palette{{
2520 {{0.55f, 0.40f, 0.22f}}, // sand, dry soil, and river sediment
2521 {{0.15f, 0.38f, 0.12f}}, // vegetation
2522 {{0.36f, 0.35f, 0.33f}}, // exposed rock
2523 {{0.88f, 0.91f, 0.94f}}, // snow
2524 }};
2525 auto *image = new image::ImageData(chunk->getSplatWidth(), chunk->getSplatHeight(), "RGBA8");
2526 auto *pixels = static_cast<uint8_t *>(image->getData());
2527 for (int vertex = 0; vertex < chunk->getBaseVertexCount(); ++vertex) {
2528 const int biome = chunk->getBiome(vertex);
2529 std::array<float, 3> semanticColor{};
2530 bool useSemanticColor = true;
2531 if (biome == int(Biome::Ocean))
2532 semanticColor = {0.035f, 0.16f, 0.25f};
2533 else if (biome == int(Biome::River))
2534 semanticColor = {0.24f, 0.18f, 0.09f};
2535 else if (biome == int(Biome::Lake))
2536 semanticColor = {0.12f, 0.19f, 0.14f};
2537 else if (biome == int(Biome::Wetland))
2538 semanticColor = {0.12f, 0.28f, 0.07f};
2539 else if (biome == int(Biome::Beach))
2540 semanticColor = {0.42f, 0.34f, 0.19f};
2541 else
2542 useSemanticColor = false;
2543 for (int component = 0; component < 3; ++component) {
2544 float value = semanticColor[component];
2545 if (!useSemanticColor) {
2546 value = 0.f;
2547 for (int channel = 0; channel < 4; ++channel)
2548 value += chunk->getMaterialWeight(vertex, channel) * palette[channel][component];
2549 }
2550 pixels[size_t(vertex) * 4u + size_t(component)] = uint8_t(std::lround(std::clamp(value, 0.f, 1.f) * 255.f));
2551 }
2552 pixels[size_t(vertex) * 4u + 3u] = 255;
2553 }
2554 return image;
2555}
2556
2557namespace {
2558float diagnosticScale(const std::vector<float> &values, float exposure) {
2559 if (std::isfinite(exposure) && exposure > 0.f) return exposure;
2560 std::vector<float> positive;
2561 positive.reserve(values.size());
2562 for (float value : values) if (std::isfinite(value) && value > 0.f) positive.push_back(value);
2563 if (positive.empty()) return 1.f;
2564 const size_t percentile = std::min(positive.size() - 1,
2565 size_t(std::floor(float(positive.size() - 1) * 0.99f)));
2566 std::nth_element(positive.begin(), positive.begin() + ptrdiff_t(percentile), positive.end());
2567 return 1.f / std::max(1e-8f, positive[percentile]);
2568}
2569
2570enum class ErosionImageMode { Combined, Wear, Deposit };
2571
2572image::ImageData *erosionDiagnosticImage(TerrainErosionMap *map, float exposure,
2573 ErosionImageMode mode) {
2574 if (!map || map->width <= 0 || map->height <= 0 ||
2575 map->wear.size() != size_t(map->width) * size_t(map->height) ||
2576 map->deposition.size() != map->wear.size()) return nullptr;
2577 const float wearScale = diagnosticScale(map->wear, exposure);
2578 const float depositScale = diagnosticScale(map->deposition, exposure);
2579 auto *result = new image::ImageData(map->width, map->height, "RGBA8");
2580 auto *pixels = static_cast<uint8_t *>(result->getData());
2581 for (size_t i = 0; i < map->wear.size(); ++i) {
2582 const float wear = std::sqrt(std::clamp(map->wear[i] * wearScale, 0.f, 1.f));
2583 const float deposit = std::sqrt(std::clamp(map->deposition[i] * depositScale, 0.f, 1.f));
2584 float r = 0.025f, g = 0.035f, b = 0.050f;
2585 if (mode == ErosionImageMode::Wear) {
2586 r += 0.95f * wear;
2587 g += 0.30f * wear;
2588 b += 0.035f * wear;
2589 } else if (mode == ErosionImageMode::Deposit) {
2590 r += 0.035f * deposit;
2591 g += 0.78f * deposit;
2592 b += 0.95f * deposit;
2593 } else {
2594 r += 0.95f * wear + 0.035f * deposit;
2595 g += 0.30f * wear + 0.78f * deposit;
2596 b += 0.035f * wear + 0.95f * deposit;
2597 }
2598 pixels[i * 4u] = uint8_t(std::lround(std::clamp(r, 0.f, 1.f) * 255.f));
2599 pixels[i * 4u + 1u] = uint8_t(std::lround(std::clamp(g, 0.f, 1.f) * 255.f));
2600 pixels[i * 4u + 2u] = uint8_t(std::lround(std::clamp(b, 0.f, 1.f) * 255.f));
2601 pixels[i * 4u + 3u] = 255;
2602 }
2603 return result;
2604}
2605} // namespace

2607image::ImageData *Procgen::generateTerrainErosionMap(TerrainErosionMap *erosion, float exposure) {

2609 image::ImageData *result = erosionDiagnosticImage(erosion, exposure, ErosionImageMode::Combined);
2610 if (!result) lastError_ = "generateTerrainErosionMap: valid erosion diagnostics are required";
2611 return result;

2629graphics::Shader *Procgen::createTerrainMaterialShader(graphics::Graphics *gfx) {
2630 lastError_.clear();
2631 if (!gfx) {
2632 lastError_ = "createTerrainMaterialShader: graphics is required";
2633 return nullptr;
2634 }
2635 static const char *fragment = R"GLSL(#version 450
2636layout(location=0) in vec3 vNormal;
2637layout(location=1) in vec2 vUV;
2638layout(location=2) in vec4 vTint;
2639layout(location=3) in vec3 vWorldPos;
2640layout(location=4) in vec3 vCameraPos;
2641layout(location=5) in vec3 vViewPos;
2642struct Light3D { vec4 posRadius; vec4 color; };
2643layout(set=0,binding=0,std140) uniform Frame {
2644 mat4 mvp; mat4 model; vec4 lightDirIntensity; vec4 lightColor; vec4 tint;
2645 vec4 cameraPos; vec4 ambient; Light3D lights[8]; vec4 texBomb; vec4 parallax;
2646 mat4 view; vec4 clipInfo; vec4 cloud; vec4 cloudWind;
2647} ubo;
2648layout(set=0,binding=1) uniform sampler2D splatSampler;
2649layout(set=0,binding=4,std140) uniform ShadowFrame {
2650 mat4 lightVP[3]; vec4 splits; vec4 bias; vec4 cascadeBias; vec4 cascadeTexel;
2651} shadow;
2652layout(set=0,binding=5) uniform sampler2DArrayShadow shadowMap;
2653layout(location=0) out vec4 outColor;
2654
2655float hash21(vec2 p) {
2656 uvec2 q = uvec2(ivec2(floor(p)));
2657 uint n = q.x * 1597334677u ^ q.y * 3812015801u;
2658 n = (n ^ (n >> 15u)) * 2246822519u;
2659 return float(n & 0x00ffffffu) / float(0x00ffffffu);
2660}
2661
2662float valueNoise(vec2 p) {
2663 vec2 i = floor(p);
2664 vec2 f = fract(p);
2665 f = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
2666 float a = hash21(i);
2667 float b = hash21(i + vec2(1.0, 0.0));
2668 float c = hash21(i + vec2(0.0, 1.0));
2669 float d = hash21(i + vec2(1.0, 1.0));
2670 return mix(mix(a, b, f.x), mix(c, d, f.x), f.y);
2671}
2672float terrainShadow(vec3 worldPos, float viewDepth) {
2673 if (shadow.bias.y < 0.5 || shadow.bias.z < 0.5 || shadow.splits.w < 1e-4)
2674 return 1.0;
2675 int cascade = viewDepth < shadow.splits.x ? 0 : (viewDepth < shadow.splits.y ? 1 : 2);
2676 vec4 clip = shadow.lightVP[cascade] * vec4(worldPos, 1.0);
2677 vec3 ndc = clip.xyz / max(clip.w, 1e-6);
2678 vec2 uv = ndc.xy * 0.5 + 0.5;
2679 if (uv.x <= 0.0 || uv.x >= 1.0 || uv.y <= 0.0 || uv.y >= 1.0 ||
2680 ndc.z <= 0.0 || ndc.z >= 1.0) return 1.0;
2681 float compareBias = cascade == 0 ? shadow.cascadeBias.x :
2682 (cascade == 1 ? shadow.cascadeBias.y : shadow.cascadeBias.z);
2683 if (compareBias <= 1e-8) compareBias = shadow.bias.x;
2684 vec2 texel = 1.0 / vec2(textureSize(shadowMap, 0).xy);
2685 float visibility = 0.0;
2686 for (int y = -1; y <= 1; ++y) for (int x = -1; x <= 1; ++x)
2687 visibility += texture(shadowMap,
2688 vec4(uv + vec2(x, y) * texel * 0.65, float(cascade), ndc.z - compareBias));
2689 return visibility / 9.0;
2690}
2691void main() {
2692 vec4 weights = max(texture(splatSampler, vUV), vec4(0.0));
2693 weights /= max(dot(weights, vec4(1.0)), 1e-5);
2694 const vec3 sand = vec3(0.34, 0.235, 0.115);
2695 const vec3 vegetation = vec3(0.075, 0.255, 0.055);
2696 const vec3 rock = vec3(0.285, 0.275, 0.255);
2697 const vec3 snow = vec3(0.78, 0.82, 0.86);
2698 vec3 albedo = sand * weights.r + vegetation * weights.g +
2699 rock * weights.b + snow * weights.a;
2700 float macro = mix(0.88, 1.12, valueNoise(vWorldPos.xz * 0.55));
2701 float fine = mix(0.94, 1.06, valueNoise(vWorldPos.xz * 5.0 + vec2(17.0, 31.0)));
2702 albedo *= macro * fine * vTint.rgb;
2703 float roughness = dot(weights, vec4(0.82, 0.94, 0.68, 0.52));
2704 vec3 N = normalize(vNormal);
2705 vec3 V = normalize(vCameraPos - vWorldPos);
2706 if (dot(N, V) < 0.0) N = -N;
2707 vec2 detailP = vWorldPos.xz * 4.0;
2708 float detail0 = valueNoise(detailP);
2709 float detailX = valueNoise(detailP + vec2(0.08, 0.0));
2710 float detailZ = valueNoise(detailP + vec2(0.0, 0.08));
2711 N = normalize(N + vec3(detail0 - detailX, 0.0, detail0 - detailZ) *
2712 mix(0.16, 0.045, weights.a));
2713 vec3 L = normalize(ubo.lightDirIntensity.xyz);
2714 vec3 H = normalize(V + L);
2715 float ndl = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);
2716 float wrap = ndl * 0.88 + 0.12;
2717 float specPower = mix(96.0, 5.0, roughness);
2718 float spec = pow(max(dot(N, H), 0.0), specPower) * mix(0.22, 0.035, roughness);
2719 vec3 sky = ubo.ambient.rgb * mix(vec3(0.72, 0.64, 0.55), vec3(1.05), N.y * 0.5 + 0.5);
2720 float viewDepth = max(-vViewPos.z, 0.0);
2721 float visibility = terrainShadow(vWorldPos, viewDepth);
2722 vec3 color = albedo * (sky + ubo.lightColor.rgb * wrap * visibility) +
2723 ubo.lightColor.rgb * spec * visibility;
2724 color = color / (color + vec3(0.72));
2725 float nearZ = max(ubo.clipInfo.x, 1e-4);
2726 float farZ = max(ubo.clipInfo.y, nearZ + 1e-3);
2727 float linearDepth = clamp((viewDepth - nearZ) / (farZ - nearZ), 0.0, 1.0);
2728 outColor = vec4(color, linearDepth);
2729}
2730)GLSL";
2731 try {
2732 return gfx->newMeshShader(fragment);
2733 } catch (const std::exception &e) {
2734 lastError_ = std::string("createTerrainMaterialShader: ") + e.what();
2735 return nullptr;
2736 }
2737}
2738
2739graphics::Shader *Procgen::createTerrainWaterShader(graphics::Graphics *gfx) {
2740 lastError_.clear();
2741 if (!gfx) {
2742 lastError_ = "createTerrainWaterShader: graphics is required";
2743 return nullptr;
2744 }
2745 static const char *fragment = R"GLSL(#version 450
2746layout(location=0) in vec3 vNormal;
2747layout(location=1) in vec2 vUV;
2748layout(location=2) in vec4 vTint;
2749layout(location=3) in vec3 vWorldPos;
2750layout(location=4) in vec3 vCameraPos;
2751layout(location=5) in vec3 vViewPos;
2752struct Light3D { vec4 posRadius; vec4 color; };
2753layout(set=0,binding=0,std140) uniform Frame {
2754 mat4 mvp; mat4 model; vec4 lightDirIntensity; vec4 lightColor; vec4 tint;
2755 vec4 cameraPos; vec4 ambient; Light3D lights[8]; vec4 texBomb; vec4 parallax;
2756 mat4 view; vec4 clipInfo; vec4 cloud; vec4 cloudWind;
2757} ubo;
2758layout(location=0) out vec4 outColor;
2759void main() {
2760 vec2 p = vWorldPos.xz;
2761 float wx = sin(p.x * 1.7 + p.y * 0.43) + 0.55 * sin(p.x * 4.1 - p.y * 1.3);
2762 float wz = cos(p.y * 1.9 - p.x * 0.37) + 0.55 * cos(p.y * 3.7 + p.x * 1.1);
2763 vec3 N = normalize(vec3(wx * 0.055, 1.0, wz * 0.055));
2764 vec3 V = normalize(vCameraPos - vWorldPos);
2765 vec3 L = normalize(ubo.lightDirIntensity.xyz);
2766 vec3 H = normalize(V + L);
2767 float ndv = max(dot(N, V), 0.0);
2768 float ndl = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);
2769 float fresnel = 0.035 + 0.50 * pow(1.0 - ndv, 4.0);
2770 float glint = pow(max(dot(N, H), 0.0), 150.0) * 1.15;
2771 vec3 deep = vec3(0.018, 0.16, 0.205);
2772 vec3 shallow = vec3(0.045, 0.36, 0.39);
2773 vec3 water = mix(deep, shallow, 0.35 + 0.25 * N.y);
2774 water *= mix(vec3(1.0), max(vTint.rgb, vec3(0.12)), 0.18);
2775 vec3 sky = ubo.ambient.rgb * mix(vec3(0.55, 0.72, 0.82), vec3(1.0), fresnel);
2776 vec3 color = water * (0.72 + 0.58 * ndl) + sky * fresnel +
2777 ubo.lightColor.rgb * glint;
2778 color = color / (color + vec3(0.68));
2779 float nearZ = max(ubo.clipInfo.x, 1e-4);
2780 float farZ = max(ubo.clipInfo.y, nearZ + 1e-3);
2781 float viewDepth = max(-vViewPos.z, 0.0);
2782 float linearDepth = clamp((viewDepth - nearZ) / (farZ - nearZ), 0.0, 1.0);
2783 outColor = vec4(color, linearDepth);
2784}
2785)GLSL";
2786 try {
2787 return gfx->newMeshShader(fragment);
2788 } catch (const std::exception &e) {
2789 lastError_ = std::string("createTerrainWaterShader: ") + e.what();
2790 return nullptr;
2791 }
2792}

3663void Procgen::expose(ssq::Class &cls) {
3664 cls.addFunc("getName", &Procgen::getName);
3665 cls.addFunc("newParams", [vm = cls.getHandle()](Procgen*) -> ssq::Table {
3666 return makeOwnedProxy<ProcgenParamsHandleRef, ScriptProcgenParams>(

3668 });

3672 });
3673 cls.addFunc("newOutput", [vm = cls.getHandle()](Procgen*) -> ssq::Table {
3674 auto* module = Procgen::create();
3675 return makeOwnedNativeProxy<OutputSpec>(
3676 vm, module->newOutputHandle(), [module](ProcgenOutputHandleRef ref) { return module->resolveOutput(ref); },
3677 [](ProcgenOutputHandleRef ref) {
3678 auto* owner = ModuleManager::getInstance<Procgen>("Procgen");
3679 return owner ? owner->releaseOutput(ref)
3680 : procgenBindingFailure<void>(eve::DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
3681 "Procgen module is no longer loaded", "output");
3682 });

3688 [module](ProcgenPointSetHandleRef ref) { return module->resolvePointSet(ref); },
3689 [](ProcgenPointSetHandleRef ref) {

3693 "Procgen module is no longer loaded", "pointSet");
3694 });

3698 float jitter) -> ssq::Table {

3702 [module](ProcgenPointSetHandleRef ref) { return module->resolvePointSet(ref); },
3703 [](ProcgenPointSetHandleRef ref) {

3714 return makeOwnedPointSetProxy(
3715 vm, procgenBindingFailure<ProcgenPointSetHandleRef>(eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
3716 "filterHeight requires owned points", "points"));
3717 return makeOwnedPointSetProxy(vm, value->filterHeightHandle(*reference, minimum, maximum));

4296 cls.addFunc("publishCellSnapshot", [vm = cls.getHandle()](
4297 Procgen* value, const std::string& prefix, ProcgenCellRequest* request,
4298 PointSet* points, const std::string& revisionText,
4299 const std::string& assetAttribute, const std::string& defaultAsset) {
4300 const auto pointsRef = nativeProxyReference<ProcgenPointSetHandleRef>(points);
4301 std::uint64_t targetRevision = 0;
4302 const auto [end, error] =
4303 std::from_chars(revisionText.data(), revisionText.data() + revisionText.size(), targetRevision);
4304 if (!value || !request || !pointsRef || error != std::errc{} ||
4305 end != revisionText.data() + revisionText.size() || targetRevision == 0)
4306 return eve::script::projectResult(
4307 vm,
4308 procgenBindingFailure<std::uint64_t>(
4309 eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
4310 "publishCellSnapshot requires request, owned points, and a non-zero decimal target revision",
4311 "publishCellSnapshot"),
4312 [](std::uint64_t committed) { return eve::Value(std::to_string(committed)); });
4313 return eve::script::projectResult(
4314 vm, value->publishCellSnapshot(prefix, *request, *pointsRef, targetRevision, assetAttribute, defaultAsset),
4315 [](std::uint64_t committed) { return eve::Value(std::to_string(committed)); });
4316 });

4352 cls.addFunc("synchronizeCellInstancesAtomic", [vm = cls.getHandle()](Procgen* value, const std::string& prefix,
4353 ssq::Array runtimeArray,
4354 ssq::Array requestArray,
4355 const std::string& assetAttribute,
4356 const std::string& defaultAsset) {
4357 std::vector<const RuntimeGeneration*> runtimes;
4358 std::vector<const ProcgenCellRequest*> requests;
4359 if (runtimeArray.size() == requestArray.size()) {
4360 runtimes.reserve(runtimeArray.size());
4361 requests.reserve(requestArray.size());
4362 for (size_t index = 0; index < runtimeArray.size(); ++index) {
4363 runtimes.push_back(runtimeArray.get<RuntimeGeneration*>(index));
4364 requests.push_back(requestArray.get<ProcgenCellRequest*>(index));
4365 }
4366 }
4367 return eve::script::projectResult(
4368 vm,
4369 value ? value->synchronizeCellInstancesAtomic(prefix, runtimes, requests, assetAttribute, defaultAsset)
4370 : procgenBindingFailure<std::uint64_t>(eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
4371 "synchronizeCellInstancesAtomic requires Procgen", "procgen"),
4372 [](std::uint64_t committed) { return eve::Value(std::to_string(committed)); });
4373 });
